pages.title: Regular gas, number one · 1/3
paragraphs: It is four o’clock on a hot afternoon in Austin. Ana drives into a gas station with a nearly empty tank. She stops her car next to pump number three. The pump has many buttons and a small screen. An employee named Gus walks over. He sees that she is not sure what to do.
“Hi! Do you need help with the pump?” says Gus. “Yes. Which button is for regular gas?” says Ana. “The green button, number one.” says Gus.
